subject: general
question: 15 people can do a piece of work in 12 days. How many people can complete the same work in 20 days?
solution:
**Given:**

15 people is doing a work in 12 days

**Concept used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

Here,

M1 = People at the 1st case

D1 = Time at the 1st case

M2 = People at the 2nd case

D2 = Time at the 2nd case 

**Calculation:**

According to the concept,

M1 = 15

D1 = 12

D2 = 20

Let M₂ be x

So,

15 × 12 = x × 20

⇒ 180 = 20x

⇒ x = 180/20

⇒ x = 9

So, M2 = 9 people

**∴ 9 people can complete the same work in 20 days.**
